name: Glass Noodles (Cellophane)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as they're made from mung bean starch rather than grain flour. Light and easy to digest.
preparationTips: Soak in hot water for 5-10 minutes until soft and translucent
Don't overcook as they become mushy quickly
Rinse with cold water after cooking to prevent sticking
Cut with scissors for easier eating in soups and stir-fries
nutritionalHighlights: Contains small amounts of iron and potassium
